Each judge has judge='claude-code', mode, timeout, isolated, prompt_template='prompt.md' and no model/temperature keys. Each prompt.md contains exactly the {criteria} and {app_context} placeholders and no other brace tokens, so templating will not fail. Shell: `bash -n` passes for tests/test.sh and solution/solve.sh; both start with '#!/bin/bash'; zero CR characters in either, and `grep -rlI $'\r'` finds no CR in any task file. tests/test.sh, tests/scoring.toml, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/Dockerfile and tests/.dockerignore are byte-identical to the frozen template. score.py and restart_mcp.py compile with py_compile. Reference entry: test.sh:68 requires /app/server.js and launches `node $APP_ENTRY` (test.sh:97-111); solve.sh:35 copies solution/app/. into /app, which contains server.js -> require('./src/index.js') -> bootstrap.js/db.js (reads src/seed_data.json, present). `node --check` (v24.19.0) passes for server.js, src/bootstrap.js, src/db.js, src/index.js, public/js/app.js, board.js, threads.js. Its only npm dependencies, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (package.json:13-16), are installed globally in both environment/Dockerfile:9-12 and tests/Dockerfile:16-22 with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, which test.sh passes at line 106. The app listens on PORT||3000 (bootstrap.js:43), and integration.md:5-9 publishes /app/server.js, port 3000, DB_PATH and /api/health. Runtime observation: results/workspace.json records 18/18 scripted golden groups passed and page_errors=[], run in hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair as uid 65534 with a real restart; server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice. Budget nesting parses consistently: gate judge timeouts 600+600 <= 1500 (test.sh:213), scored 9000+900+900=10800 <= 11100 (test.sh:224) with --max-concurrent-agent 1, and 1500+11100=12600 <= verifier timeout_sec 13200. Adversarial: (a) a broken submission with no /app/server.js, or with a symlink escaping /app/node_modules, exits early through test.sh:68-83 with the zero reward already written (test.sh:60), so it cannot pass by a parse quirk. (b) A conforming alternative, such as an ESM server.js or one with a vendored /app/node_modules, still runs: the entry is fixed only by filename, and local node_modules are allowed. I found no conforming entry that the harness would fail to launch. Caveats outside this row: this is a parser and source check plus a scripted golden run. It is not a full configured rewardkit or judge run, Oracle grade or model score, and none was claimed. RewardKit's own judge.toml schema loading was not executed here, but the files are structurally the same as the frozen template's.
